title: Pretraining and Test-Time Training Budgets Matter for ARC: A Controlled Study of VARC and TRM
abstract: arXiv:2610.13660v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) is increasingly used to evaluate whether neural networks can infer task-specific transformations from few demonstrations. Recent ARC models differ in architecture, but also in broader training and evaluation protocols, including pretraining data, data augmentation, test-time setup, and optimization budgets, making conclusions about architecture benefits debatable. In this work, we study how the performance of the vision-inspired VARC and recursion-based TRM models is affected by pretraining and test-time training (TTT) budgets under a common inductive protocol on ARC-AGI-1. We cross five pretraining budgets with four TTT budgets for each test task. Each budget specifies a task-variant count and total sample presentations, defining the controlled training budgets. We observe that increasing TTT sample presentations improves the standard ARC pass@2 metric in all settings for both models. Increas

translated_title: 预训练与测试时训练预算对ARC至关重要：VARC与TRM的对照研究
translated_abstract: 抽象与推理语料库（ARC）越来越多地被用于评估神经网络能否从少量示例中推断出任务特定的变换。近期的ARC模型不仅在架构上存在差异，在更广泛的训练与评估协议上也各不相同，包括预训练数据、数据增强、测试时设置和优化预算，这使得关于架构优势的结论备受争议。在本工作中，我们在ARC-AGI-1上采用统一的归纳协议，研究视觉启发的VARC模型与基于递归的TRM模型的性能如何受预训练和测试时训练（TTT）预算的影响。我们将五个预训练预算与每个测试任务的四个TTT预算进行交叉组合，每个预算规定了任务变体数量和总样本呈现次数，从而定义了受控的训练预算。我们观察到，在所有设置下，增加TTT样本呈现次数均能提升两种模型的标准ARC pass@2指标。
tldr: 本文在统一协议下控制变量地对比视觉型VARC与递归型TRM模型，证明预训练与测试时训练预算（尤其是增加TTT样本呈现次数）对ARC性能有决定性影响，提示性能差异不能简单归因于架构本身。
en_tdlr: This controlled study on ARC-AGI-1 shows that pretraining and test-time training budgets, rather than architecture alone, drive performance differences between VARC and TRM, with increased TTT sample presentations consistently improving pass@2.
